greeting.text: So the Lightbearer's heir has come after all. I wondered if you would. You have walked a very long way to stand in front of me, and you are tired, and I admire that. I have a proposal. Stand with me, and I will give you half of Vaelmoor to rule as you like, and you will never be hungry or afraid again. Will you?

choices.text: Yes. I will stand with you.

effects.game_over: The Sovereign smiles, and the hall tilts, and the floor comes up very gently to meet you. He has put you to sleep. You will sleep a long time, and in the end the dark that he promised will be quite complete.

choices.text: No. I have come for the Dawnglass, and for you.

effects.message: "Then you are a fool," says Maldrath, rising, "and a brave one. It will make no difference."
